captured_cases.expected_outcome: The real round-5 request declaring activation_cards[].approver as introduced starts, and promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the field.
The real misspelled request is still refused at start with the available keys.
An introduced flag on a field the module already carries is refused by name.
The real structured-KPI request without any introduced flag still starts exactly as before.

atomic_step.outcome: An atom may declare a structured field it introduces: start accepts it when the field's parent resolves and the leaf does not exist yet, records it as introduced, and record-promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the leaf; a misspelled field and an introduced flag on an existing field are refused at start by name.
atomic_step.practical_value: Round 5 of the S12 roadmap adds three structured fields; the machinery can build those atoms without hiding the field's addition from the atom's own change record.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: The real refused round-5 request starts through the candidate controller and its promotion gate refuses until the field exists; the real misspelled request and an introduced-on-existing field are refused by name; the real structured-KPI request still starts; the promoted controller is installed to both projections at parity and the real request starts through the installed controller.

composition.assembly_contract: Use only the winner's three declared paths and preserve every unrelated lifecycle boundary.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any metric fails on any case, or the promoted controller refuses the real request.
final_validation.operator_path: Run the candidate controller's real start against the real United Partners repository for every frozen request and its promotion-time validation for the introduced field; promoted validation then starts the real round-5 request through the installed controller.
final_validation.success_criterion: All four candidate metrics pass every case, followed by the promoted real operator path.

approaches.hypothesis: An explicit introduced marker lets start admit the field on its parent alone while keeping every other declaration exactly resolved, and promotion resolves the leaf.
approaches.implementation: contract_surface.fields[].introduced: parent-only resolution at start, leaf refused if it already exists, full resolution required at record-promotion.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: the atom author names the new field explicitly in the request

approaches.hypothesis: Tolerating any unresolved leaf at start and resolving only at promotion is enough.
approaches.implementation: start records an unresolved leaf instead of refusing; record-promotion resolves every field.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: a misspelled field passes start and is caught only at promotion

mini_probes.goal: Decide how a field the atom introduces is admitted at start and gated at promotion.
mini_probes.practical_value: Field-adding atoms can be built through the machinery while misspellings stay refused.

proof.failure_criterion: Any ordered metric is not one on any frozen case.
proof.success_criterion: All four ordered metrics equal one on every frozen case.

winner_output.description: The measured controller, skill text and tests for introduced-field declarations.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Field resolution, refusals and the promotion gate are deterministic code decisions; no model judgement is involved.
